name: Crisis of Faith
body:
School enchantment (emotion, mind-affecting); Level antipaladin 2, cleric/oracle 3, inquisitor 3, lathspell 2, paladin 3

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5ft./2 levels)
Target one creature
Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw Will partial; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You utter words that shake the target’s faith in their beliefs or their deity. The mental turmoil deals 1d6/caster level damage (maximum 10d6). If the target is able to cast divine spells, they instead take 1d8/caster level (maximum 10d8) damage and must make concentration checks to cast their divine spells for 1 round as if needing to cast defensively. A successful Will save halves this damage and negates the need for concentration checks if applicable.
